mapper.sql: accommodation_booking_id, trip_id, user_id, check_in, check_out, offer_id, provider, name, accommodation_type, area_label, address, rating, latitude, longitude, quoted_nightly_price, quoted_total_price, quoted_currency, quoted_price_source, quoted_at, rooms, adults, user_reported_booked, user_reported_at, booking_ref, booking_ref_added_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation_bookings ( trip_id, user_id, check_in, check_out, offer_id, provider, name, accommodation_type, area_label, address, rating, latitude, longitude, quoted_nightly_price, quoted_total_price, quoted_currency, quoted_price_source, quoted_at, rooms, adults ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{userId}, #{checkIn}, #{checkOut}, #{offerId}, #{provider}, #{name}, #{accommodationType}, #{areaLabel}, #{address}, #{rating}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{quotedNightlyPrice}, #{quotedTotalPrice}, #{quotedCurrency}, #{quotedPriceSource}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{rooms}, #{adults} ) ON CONFLICT (trip_id, check_in, check_out) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, offer_id = EXCLUDED.offer_id, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, name = EXCLUDED.name, accommodation_type = EXCLUDED.accommodation_type, area_label = EXCLUDED.area_label, address = EXCLUDED.address, rating = EXCLUDED.rating, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, quoted_nightly_price = EXCLUDED.quoted_nightly_price, quoted_total_price = EXCLUDED.quoted_total_price, quoted_currency = EXCLUDED.quoted_currency, quoted_price_source = EXCLUDED.quoted_price_source, quoted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rooms = EXCLUDED.rooms, adults = EXCLUDED.adults, user_reported_booked = FALSE, user_reported_at = NULL, booking_ref = NULL, booking_ref_added_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM accommodation_bookings WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY check_in, accommodation_booking_id
mapper.update: UPDATE accommodation_bookings SET user_reported_booked = #{userReportedBooked}, user_reported_at = CASE WHEN #{userReportedBooked} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE accommodation_booking_id = #{accommodationBookingId}

UPDATE accommodation_bookings SET booking_ref = NULLIF(TRIM(#{bookingRef}), ''), booking_ref_added_at = CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(#{bookingRef}), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END WHERE accommodation_booking_id = #{accommodationBookingId}
